userLogNoteText: Just added a yo file to step sambro down from 600 - 800m.
Just successfully completed 2 400m dives, just added a yo to step the dive down to 600m.

Sambro aborted for stalling at the beginning of its dive at 4:35 UTC then sequenced into lastgasp.mi. It was in lastgasp until around 1030 UTC before I caught it. In lastgasp.mi it seemed to be diving to 100m with no issue. I sent off an .mlg and a .dbd and I couldn't determine any reason for the stall from the data. I sent it on back on mission but plan to step down the dives starting at 200m.
hit first wpt, sent new goto with initial wpt set to -1

pushed back UTC timer to 1030utc & ctd to sample from 10-13 on dive.  The idea is to capture the 2nd yo of segment so as to not have an extra surfacing for nocomms and also to not have a small segment
set the dives to 24 deg rather than 26
Bumped up utc time to 0530 UTC, and changed CTD sample time to 0500 - 0830.  To try to avoid the extra pump use per day
Updated surfac15 UTC timer to use autoballast to avoid surfacing too quickly at 8:00 UTC so that the ctd start and surfacing are at the same time
Set the script to TC_safe_g3s, so it gives a ctrl -e to potentially reduce the lost calls during transfer

increased nocomms to 9 hours (surfac11), set surfac15 (utc) to surface at 0800 but just resume, set sample10 (ctd) to sample during dive at TOD 0750 -> 1000, which should cover a little more than the dive to 950m

finished calibration, seemed succusfull. Went from ~30% error to 0.7%. 
Edited to run one single 950m test yo, turned on low power mode, set c/d_bpump to -300/+300 to start autoballast
running attcal.mi to see if our 'current' we are fighting is just a poorly calibrated compass
Increasing num half yos to 4 (was 2), diving to 950 and up to 10
After completing final checks, sambro is now flying 2 half yos to 950m. The sbdlist has been set back to low res
